title: Prince of Tyre — not a mere man
english: Lament the [[prince of Tyre >> Bible:Ezekiel 28:12]] — no mere man: [[placed with the cherub in Eden >> Bible:Ezekiel 28:13-14]]. Read with Daniel’s [[prince Michael >> Bible:Daniel 10:13]] and Paul’s [[glory to all who do good >> Bible:Romans 2:10]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Pharaoh too; invisible princes
english: Likewise weigh [[Pharaoh king of Egypt >> Bible:Ezekiel 29:2-3]] among invisible rulers, not flesh alone. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
